# God's Grace Hair Braiding

> Fast, neat & cute based in Georgetown, Texas. Knotless, boho, twists, cornrows and kids' styles in Georgetown. Quick, gentle and friendly, and they check you love it before they keep going.

- Phone: (409) 995-9173

## Services
- Knotless braids: Medium or small knotless from shoulder to butt length, blended to your color and kept lightweight. Braiding hair included.
- Boho & French curl: Knotless and box braids with loose curls left through, plus French curl, for a soft, full look.
- Twists: Knotless, Senegalese, kinky and island twists, neat and even from root to curly end.
- Cornrows & feed-ins: Feed-in cornrows, ponytails, Fulani and tree braids, laid clean from the hairline back.
- Kids & men: Kids' styles with beads, plus braids and twists for men and boys.
- Locs, crochet & sew-ins: Loc starts and repairs, sisterlocks, faux locs, crochet braids and sew-ins.

## About
God's Grace Hair Braiding is a braiding salon at 612 E University Ave #6 in Georgetown, with more than 8 years of braiding behind it. The motto is right there on the logo: fast, neat and cute. Clients keep saying the same things: the braiders listen to what you ask for, they work quick without rushing, and they're gentle. They braid to your hair's density instead of piling on extra hair, so braids come out light and don't pull. And the shop is friendly, with none of the mean-girl energy some braiding salons are known for. Every kind of African braiding is on the menu, from knotless and Fulani to twists, locs and kids' beads, and the salon also teaches hands-on braiding classes for anyone who wants to learn.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 8 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday 9 AM to 5 PM. Hours may differ on holidays.
- Q: Where are you located?
  A: 612 E University Ave #6, Georgetown, TX 78626, in the strip center on E University Ave near Southwestern University.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on the God's Grace booking page, or call or text (409) 995-9173.
- Q: Is the braiding hair included?
  A: For knotless braids, yes: the price includes the hair. For boho styles the curly hair is not included, and for sew-in dreadlocks you bring your own hair. Ask about other styles when you book.
- Q: How long will my appointment take?
  A: It depends on the style, size and length. Two cornrows take about 30 minutes; long small knotless can take 5 to 6 hours. One client with very dense hair was done in about 5.5 hours.
- Q: Can you keep my braids lightweight?
  A: Yes. Clients with fine hair say the braiders work to their density instead of adding too much hair.
- Q: What if I need to cancel?
  A: There is a 30% fee for no-shows or cancellations within 1 hour of your appointment.
- Q: Do you teach braiding classes?
  A: Yes: 2-hour hands-on classes in cornrows, feed-ins, box braids, twists and knotless, from $50. A mannequin head and braiding kit are provided.
